parameters.name: ApplicationIdentityType
parameters.description:
The application identity type. Default value: application. Valid values:
- application: application.
- agent: agent.

parameters.name: ApplicationSourceType
parameters.description:
The source from which the application is created. Valid values:
- urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template: application template.
- urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard: standard protocol.

parameters.name: ApplicationTemplateId
parameters.description: The application template ID. This parameter is required when ApplicationSourceType is set to urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template.

parameters.name: LogoUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the application logo.

parameters.name: SsoType
parameters.description:
The single sign-on protocol. Valid values:
- saml2: SAML 2.0 protocol.
- oidc: OpenID Connect protocol.
